title: Model-Adaptive and Risk-Constrained Frequency Hopping Against Predictive Jammers
abstract: arXiv:2609.06514v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adaptive frequency hopping against predictive jamming must address both model uncertainty and policy exposure: the context-loss relationship may vary across operating regimes, while persistent hopping patterns may expose high-probability channels to attack. We propose D-PACT-AFH, a model-adaptive and risk-constrained adversarial contextual-bandit framework in which a Tsallis-FTRL master combines a global linear learner with a partitioned local learner and selects the model class online. D-PACT-Hit incorporates channel-wise marginal hit risk into model selection, while D-PACT-Safe applies a minimum-Kullback-Leibler projection to enforce a per-slot risk budget. We establish estimator validity under non-anticipating attacks, an oracle decomposition relative to the better fixed base, and an exact conditional-risk guarantee for the Safe projection. translated_title: 针对预测性干扰机的模型自适应与风险约束跳频
translated_abstract: 面对预测性干扰的自适应跳频必须同时应对模型不确定性与策略暴露两大问题：上下文与损失之间的关系可能随工作环境的变化而改变，而持续固定的跳频模式可能使高概率信道暴露于攻击之中。我们提出了D-PACT-AFH，一个模型自适应且风险受约束的对抗性上下文多臂老虎机框架，其中Tsallis-FTRL主算法将全局线性学习器与分区局部学习器相结合，并在线选择模型类别。D-PACT-Hit将信道级的边际命中风险纳入模型选择过程，而D-PACT-Safe则采用最小Kullback-Leibler投影来强制执行每个时隙的风险预算。我们在非预知攻击条件下证明了估计器的有效性，给出了相对于更优固定基学习器的oracle分解，并为Safe投影提供了精确的条件风险保证。在多种信道环境和干扰机类型上的实验证明了该方法具备有效的模型自适应能力。
tldr: 提出了D-PACT-AFH框架，一种针对预测性干扰的模型自适应且风险受约束的对抗性上下文老虎机跳频方法，通过在线模型选择与KL投影风险预算，有效兼顾了环境变化下的模型适应性和跳频策略的抗暴露安全性。
en_tdlr: Proposes D-PACT-AFH, a model-adaptive and risk-constrained adversarial contextual-bandit framework for frequency hopping against predictive jammers, which achieves both model adaptability across regimes and safety against channel exposure through online model selection and KL-projection risk budgets.
